body.heading: Ears only
paragraphs: Sit comfortably and close your eyes. Your adult will make a sound. Your ears must do all the work.
Was that keys jingling? Paper scrunching? Water pouring? Guess out loud, then peek and see if you were right.

body.heading: Sounds have clues
paragraphs: Listen for clues. A metal sound rings. A paper sound rustles. A water sound splashes and trickles.
Hard sounds might be two things mixed — a spoon stirring a cup hides a clink and a swirl in one sound.

body.heading: Score the game
paragraphs: Give yourself a point for every sound you name. Play ten sounds and see if you can beat your own score next time.
Your ears collect far more than you realise. This game wakes them up.

takeaway: Guessing sounds with your eyes closed shows how clever your ears are at collecting clues.
materials: Household objects chosen by an adult
safetyNotes: Only an adult chooses and makes the sounds, using safe objects. Keep sounds gentle — nothing loud near ears.
screenFreeExtension: Swap roles and make sounds for your adult to guess — three points for the sound that fools them.
